Mitun, also known as Mithuna or Jupiter, is one of the Navagrahas (nine planets) in Hindu astrology. According to the Puranas, Mitun was the son of Surya, the sun god, and his wife Sanjana. He is considered to be the planet of growth, expansion, and abundance.
